resources.string: Shows live status while local VPN packet capture is active
Capturing and analyzing device network traffic locally
Start the local VPN sniffer to intercept, dissect, and inspect real-time TCP, UDP, DNS, HTTP, and TLS packets without root—or open a saved .pcap file.

Piraíba uses Android's VpnService to create a local, on-device loopback tunnel (tun0) so you can passively capture and inspect your device's network packets without root.

• What is accessed: IP, TCP, UDP, DNS, HTTP, and TLS metadata and unencrypted payloads passing through this device.
• Where data goes: 100% stays in local device memory (up to 4,000 packets). Traffic is forwarded directly to its destination and is never routed through any remote VPN server.
• No collection or tracking: Piraíba contains no ads, analytics, or background uploads. Reverse DNS queries are disabled by default. Files are written or shared only when you export a .pcap capture.
• User responsibility: Use Piraíba only on devices and networks you own or are authorized to inspect. You are solely responsible for how and what you capture, export, or do with this app; the developer assumes no liability for user actions.
